messages.author: Serguei Vassiliev
messages.body:
Hello, hope you’re doing well! I wanted to ask about the installation setup for pysander — it’s currently using the deprecated setuptools method that creates .egg files. Our HPC cluster has completely blocked .egg installs, so I’m stuck trying to deploy it. Every other Python module installs fine with pip, but pysander is being tricky. Any suggestions for a workaround? And are there plans to switch the install process to using pip-compatible methods down the line?
Thanks in advance.
Serguei
